stories.title: Javier Aguirre se despide de la prensa mexicana; inicia su aventura con el Valencia

en.title: Javier Aguirre says goodbye to Mexican press; begins his adventure with Valencia
en.summary: Javier Aguirre is departing from Mexican media to start a new position with Valencia.

stories.title: Lee Jae-Myung inicia visita de Estado en México para fortalecer lazos bilaterales y comerciales

en.title: Lee Jae-Myung begins state visit to Mexico to strengthen bilateral and commercial ties
en.summary: Mexico and South Korea are reactivating high-level diplomatic engagement following a 16-year gap in state visits.

stories.title: Presidente de Corea visita México; busca reforzar coordinación bilateral para combatir narcotráfico y trata de personas

en.title: President of Korea visits Mexico; seeks to strengthen bilateral coordination to combat drug trafficking and human trafficking
en.summary: South Korea's president is visiting Mexico to coordinate efforts on security issues including drug trafficking and human trafficking.

stories.title: Ariadna Montiel cuestiona voto contra reforma de doble nacionalidad; "al pueblo no se le sirve un pasaporte de repuesto bajo el brazo"

en.title: Ariadna Montiel questions vote against dual nationality reform; "the people are not served a spare passport under their arm"
en.summary: Ariadna Montiel argued that those seeking to govern Mexico must maintain exclusive loyalty to the country regarding dual nationality policy.

stories.title: Estados Unidos reconoce ocho intentos de suicidio en el portaviones Lincoln

en.title: United States acknowledges eight suicide attempts on aircraft carrier Lincoln
en.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln, which departed San Diego in November 2025 for operations in the South China Sea before being redirected to the Middle East in February to support US-Israel actions against Iran, experienced eight suicide attempts among its crew.

stories.title: Llega Presidente de Corea del Sur a México

en.title: President of South Korea arrives in Mexico
en.summary: Lee Jae-Myung, President of South Korea, arrived in Mexico for a state visit where he will meet with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum and Mexico City Mayor Clara Brugada.

stories.title: Lee Jae Myung, presidente de Corea, llega a México; se reunirá mañana con Sheinbaum en Palacio Nacional

en.title: Lee Jae Myung, president of South Korea, arrives in Mexico; will meet with Sheinbaum tomorrow at National Palace
en.summary: Lee Jae-Myung, South Korea's president, landed at Mexico City's international airport and was received by Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco ahead of his scheduled meeting with President Sheinbaum.

stories.title: EU reconoce 8 intentos de suicidio en el portaviones Lincoln; asegura que no registra muertes durante el despliegue

en.title: US acknowledges 8 suicide attempts on aircraft carrier Lincoln; reports no deaths during deployment
en.summary: Eight suicide attempts occurred aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln among crew members, pilots, and other personnel in the carrier strike group, with no fatalities reported during the deployment.

stories.title: Valencia sacó a Javier Aguirre del limbo "en cinco minutos"

en.title: Valencia brought Javier Aguirre out of limbo "in five minutes"
en.summary: Former Mexican national team coach Javier Aguirre was considering retirement when Valencia made him an offer. At 67 years old, he states he remains enthusiastic about continuing his coaching career.

stories.title: México ya cuenta con 130.9 millones de habitantes; edad promedio continúa en aumento

en.title: Mexico now has 130.9 million inhabitants; average age continues to rise
en.summary: Mexico's population grew 3.9% in the past year, reaching 130.9 million people. The average age continues increasing amid ongoing demographic transition, according to official census data.

stories.title: Xi Jinping llega a Washington para reunirse con Trump; es su primera visita de Estado a la Casa Blanca en más de una década

en.title: Xi Jinping arrives in Washington to meet with Trump; his first state visit to the White House in over a decade
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington for his first state visit to the White House in more than ten years. The visit included ceremonial honors with military representatives and national symbols from both countries.

stories.title: Avalan diputados reforma contra doble nacionalidad entre rechazo de opositores

en.title: Deputies approve reform against dual nationality amid opposition criticism
en.summary: Mexico's Chamber of Deputies approved constitutional amendments requiring that presidents, governors, and the Mexico City head of government hold only Mexican nationality. The reform prevents candidates for these positions from acquiring or asserting any other nationality.

stories.title: Casetas y gasolineras están listas para cobros digitales, asevera Peña Merino

en.title: Toll booths and gas stations are ready for digital payments, Peña Merino asserts
en.summary: Toll collection infrastructure on highways can already read electronic tags, and over 95% of gas stations have point-of-sale terminals, according to the Digital Transformation Agency director.

stories.title: Sin iPhone 18, Qualcomm acelera su plan para sobrevivir a su salida de Apple

en.title: Without iPhone 18, Qualcomm accelerates its plan to survive its exit from Apple
en.summary: Following Apple's decision to stop using Qualcomm's connectivity chips, the company is seeking partnerships with firms like Google and Xiaomi to offset financial losses from losing Apple as a client.

stories.title: El negocio de minimis se enfría para Estafeta, pero crece el de refacciones para autos chinos

en.title: The minimis business cools for Estafeta, but the spare parts business for Chinese autos grows
en.summary: Tariff increases on low-value packages, mainly from China, have harmed the business segment and complicated UPS's acquisition of Estafeta, though demand for Chinese vehicle parts has increased.

stories.title: Primero detener la hemorragia arancelaria; después, negociar el futuro del T-MEC: Ildefonso Guajardo

en.title: First stop the tariff hemorrhage; afterwards, negotiate the future of USMCA: Ildefonso Guajardo
en.summary: The former Economy Secretary and USMCA negotiator believes the relationship between Sheinbaum and Trump will be crucial for negotiations where trade and other bilateral issues are intertwined.

stories.title: Era hijo del fundador de La Costeña, creó su empresa con 20 empleados y hoy Jumex mueve 25,116 millones

en.title: Son of La Costeña founder created his company with 20 employees and today Jumex moves 25,116 million
en.summary: Eugenio López Rodea transformed a beverage business founded in 1961 into one of Mexico's leading drinks companies with domestic and international operations.
